name: U14-5-preview-sent
steps: Please check the heading in this preview picture.

const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('.preview-draft p')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Sent with markup to Draft a short status note'));if(!p)throw Error('Missing sent preview status');const draft=p.closest('.preview-draft');if(draft.textContent.includes('Attach to this task')||draft.textContent.includes('Saved on this device'))throw Error('Sent picture looks unsent');p.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});const r=p.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.height===0||r.top<0||r.bottom>innerHeight)throw Error('Sent receipt is not visible');
